name: cloudflare/api
title: Cloudflare — API token for Workers and DNS

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Scoped token, read by Wrangler. No shape is declared: the documented cfut_ and cfat_ prefixes are recent, and tokens issued before them are still valid.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: An identifier, not a credential. Needed when the account cannot be inferred.

CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY.description: Legacy Global API Key, paired with CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL. Broader access than a token; prefer the token.

CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL.description: Only with the legacy key, and half of that pair. Do not set both auth methods.
